meta.note: The deterministic deposit payload the deposit stage shows the user: the THORChain vault address for the selected source chain (from the inbound-addresses refresh — in-memory only, never cached) + the deposit MEMO in THORNode SwapMemo.String() scheme (`=:SOL.SOL:<solanaDest>[/<refund>]`), destination = the connected Solana session pubkey (never user-typed). The user sends from their OWN external wallet attaching the memo; the app never signs or broadcasts the deposit (v1 deposit-address flow). memoSha256 pins the memo bytes.
